scheme_name: Maternity Benefit For Female Workers- JKBOCWWB
other_conditions: Must have engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months
Must be a registered female member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Jammu & Kashmir
Must be pregnant at the time of application
Membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application
Benefit is allowed only twice in the beneficiary's lifetime
benefits_summary: ₹5,000 maternity benefit per pregnancy, up to two children (maximum twice in a lifetime).
